references.text: Aaron died on Mount Hor in the fortieth year after the Israelites left Egypt, confirming the time reference to the fortieth year.
The children of Israel came to the Wilderness of Zin in the first month, indicating the timing near the end of their wilderness journey.
The Lord commanded Moses to speak everything he was told, just as Moses here speaks all that the Lord had commanded him to the children of Israel.
Moses laid his hands on Joshua and gave him a command, as the Lord had spoken, illustrating Moses' obedience to the Lord's commands.
Moses taught the people laws and statutes as the Lord his God had commanded him, confirming that he spoke all that the Lord commanded.
The Lord declared that Israel would wander in the wilderness for forty years as punishment for their disobedience, explaining the forty years mentioned here.
